games.title: Pocket Racer
games.controls: Left/Right: change lane. Enter (Start) or Z (A): start/restart.
games.goal: Pass 20 rival cars before your three shields are gone.
games.learn: A scrolling road, lane decisions and rectangle collision.
games.inspector_hint: Memory highlights activity at C005 (passes), C006 (shields) and C007/C009 (car X). Video shows object-fetch activity for the cars.
games.provenance: Original assistant-authored code, lettering, tile art, levels and synthesized sound, produced in Codex under the project owner's direction.

games.title: Moon Courier
games.controls: Left/Right: walk. Z (A): jump. Enter (Start) or Z: start/restart.
games.goal: Pick up a parcel and reach the moon base on each of three routes.
games.learn: Signed vertical velocity, gravity, ground checks, parcels and delivery state.
games.inspector_hint: Memory shows activity at C007/C008 (position), C00E (jump velocity), C016 (parcel) and C005 (deliveries). Audio shows the jump-note envelope.
games.provenance: Original assistant-authored code, lettering, tile art, levels and synthesized sound, produced in Codex under the project owner's direction.

games.title: Matcha Garden
games.controls: Arrows: move/push. X (B): reset this puzzle. Enter (Start) or Z (A): start/restart.
games.goal: Push the tea crate onto the flower in three compact garden puzzles.
games.learn: Grid movement, checking the next two cells, and a mutable tile board.
games.inspector_hint: Memory highlights board activity beginning at C200, with 32 bytes per row. Moving a crate writes both the board and the background tile map at 9800.
games.provenance: Original assistant-authored code, lettering, tile art, levels and synthesized sound, produced in Codex under the project owner's direction.

games.title: Signal Lost
games.controls: Arrows: explore. Enter (Start) or Z (A): start/restart.
games.goal: Collect all three beacons, then find the exit before the 90-second battery runs out.
games.learn: A connected maze, collectible state, timed objectives and input repeat.
games.inspector_hint: Watch memory activity at C005 (signals), C013 (battery), and the maze at C200. Collecting a beacon writes its empty tile to the background map.
games.provenance: Original assistant-authored code, lettering, tile art, levels and synthesized sound, produced in Codex under the project owner's direction.

games.title: Orbit Guard
games.controls: Left/Right: move. Hold Z (A): fire. Enter (Start) or Z: start/restart.
games.goal: Defeat 15 approaching drones before three reach your orbit.
games.learn: Independent player, projectile and enemy motion with AABB hits and enemy waves.
games.inspector_hint: Memory shows drone activity at C009/C00A and projectile activity at C010/C011. Audio shows real pulse firing tones and noise impact envelopes.
games.provenance: Original assistant-authored code, lettering, tile art, levels and synthesized sound, produced in Codex under the project owner's direction.
